user.text:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

history.assistant:
The book tracker is ready. Start it with npm start, then open http://127.0.0.1:3000.

The home page splits books into currently reading and finished. Add a book from the form, mark one finished, and open /books/<id> for the title, author, and notes. That URL is the shareable link. Books are stored in data/books.json and stay there across restarts. No accounts and no database.

npm test passed (1 test, exit 0).

tool_steps.assistant: I'll look at the workspace first, then build a small book tracker that lists current and finished books and stores them in a JSON file.
The repo is almost empty, so I'll add a small Node app with a JSON file for books and pages for the list, form, and single-book view.
